gloss: right in the middle of; in the midst of

definitions.gloss: right in the middle of; in the midst of
definitions.explanation: Indicates being at the very center or peak of an ongoing situation, season, or activity. Adds emphasis to 只中 through the intensifying prefix 真っ.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}の{真|ま}っ{只中|ただなか}だ。
{試験|しけん}{勉強|べんきょう}の{真|ま}っ{只中|ただなか}に{電話|でんわ}が{鳴|な}った。
examples.english: The phone rang right in the middle of exam studying.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}は{今|いま}、{大|おお}きな{変革|へんかく}の{真|ま}っ{只中|ただなか}にある。
examples.english: The company is right in the midst of major transformation.

notes:
An emphatic form of {只中|ただなか} (the middle of), intensified by the prefix {真|ま}っ. Used to stress that something is at its peak or that one is deeply immersed in a situation. Very common in both spoken and written Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真|ま}っ{只中|ただなか}にある: to be right in the middle of
- {真|ま}っ{只中|ただなか}にいる: to be in the midst of
- {夏|なつ}の{真|ま}っ{只中|ただなか}: the height of summer
- {仕事|しごと}の{真|ま}っ{只中|ただなか}: in the thick of work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最中|さいちゅう}: in the middle of — more neutral, commonly used for actions in progress
- {真|ま}ん{中|なか}: the very center — refers to physical location rather than a situation or time period
- {渦中|かちゅう}: in the midst of (a controversy) — implies being caught up in something turbulent
